notes.title: Siege Hammer Release Free - Buyers Compensated
notes.content:
MyDream Interactive Inc. has released Siege Hammer as a free game. Siege Hammer was never fully finished, but despite some unfinished UI issues and turret functionality, the game is still fairly playable and quite fun. 

We appreciate all of our supporters and backers, as the game wouldn't have been possible without your help. For everyone who bought Siege Hammer, you've been compensated with VR Toolbox: 360 Desktop and Cartoon Forest Props DLC!
